title: IAIso Policy File
description: Top-level configuration document for an IAIso deployment. See spec/policy/README.md.

version.description: Policy schema version. Must be exactly "1" for this spec.

enforcement_mode.description: Boot-time safety posture. 'permissive' logs a warning once per process for each degraded condition and proceeds. 'strict' refuses to construct the engine, naming the failing condition. Fail closed: a framework whose gates silently do nothing is worse than none, because it produces confidence.

max_total_tokens.description: 2.0: lifetime allowance; 0 disables. Never decays; a release does not refill it. 1.x implementations ignore it (unknown keys are ignored), so it is only enforced by 2.0 engines.

max_total_tool_calls.description: 2.0: lifetime allowance; 0 disables. Never decays; a release does not refill it. 1.x implementations ignore it (unknown keys are ignored), so it is only enforced by 2.0 engines.

max_total_steps.description: 2.0: lifetime allowance; 0 disables. Never decays; a release does not refill it. 1.x implementations ignore it (unknown keys are ignored), so it is only enforced by 2.0 engines.

empty_step_dissipation.description: 2.0 default false: per-step dissipation applies only to steps that carry work. 1.x behaviour is true.

budget_usd.description: Hard spend ceiling in USD; 0 disables. Requires model_costs.

model_costs.description: USD per 1M tokens by model name.

unpriced_model_usd_per_million.description: Price for a model missing from model_costs. 2.0 default null = the highest listed price (fail closed); 0 = free (1.x).

metadata.description: Free-form tagging; preserved but not interpreted.
